verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has its own event-to-action mechanisms: failure alerts that fire via email, Slack or webhooks when tasks fail, and tasks you trigger from your own backend code when your events occur. Cron schedules exist but are time-based, not event rules. A community comment describes it as IFTTT/Zapier-style linking in code, but there is no documented general rule engine or catalogue of event sources. missing for 10: a documented declarative event-rule/trigger system, built-in event sources beyond task failures, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Receive alerts via email, Slack notification and webhooks when your tasks fail.
